      "id": "gap-6",
      "description": "Evaluation is still needed on adversarial longitudinal sequences such as plan-to-cancel, approve-to-revoke, deadline changes, contradictory same-time updates, out-of-order ingestion, stale messages arriving late, and completion claims later corrected.",
      "classification": "ENGINEERING",
      "priority": "HIGH",
      "status": "open",
      "resolution_notes": "Resolve with a product-specific adversarial benchmark rather than additional literature. Build deterministic multi-message scenarios covering plan-to-cancel, approve-to-revoke, deadline replacement, simultaneous contradictory updates, out-of-order ingestion, late stale observations, and corrected completion claims. Define expected historical states and expected derived current state for every step, then measure transition classification accuracy, current-state resolution accuracy, history preservation, order invariance where appropriate, and behavior under conflicting evidence."

      "id": "gap-7",
      "description": "The combined representation of message time, event/effective time, deadline or constraint time, and observed collection/version time has not been benchmarked for this product's state-resolution tasks; the temporal-database paper provides a related three-time formal account rather than such an evaluation.",

      "priority": "HIGH",
      "status": "open",
      "resolution_notes": "Resolve through schema design and controlled benchmarking. Implement separate fields for message time, event/effective time, deadline or constraint time, and observation or collection/version time. Construct cases where these clocks disagree, including retroactive corrections, delayed ingestion, changed deadlines, future-effective decisions, and replayed historical messages. Compare state-resolution results against ablations that omit or conflate one or more time dimensions, and document ordering and tie-breaking semantics."
    },

      "id": "gap-8",

Test replayability, auditability, correction and supersession handling, deterministic reconstruction, provenance traversal from current state to source observations, and preservation of prior assessments after later revisions."
    }
